figures.finding: The Australian Writers' Guild has negotiated television agreements with Screen Producers Australia: Series and Serials (SASA, 2008), Miniseries and Telemovies (MATA, 2010) and Children's Television (CTA, 2011), each carried forward with 2026 rates; for features it offers only a recommended agreement.

value.feature: recommended Feature Film Agreement and Feature Film Option Agreement (not negotiated)
value.rates_status: standard minimum rates the AWG has negotiated over many years, accepted as an industrial standard

figures.applies: Australian television drama made by SPA members; features under recommended terms.

sources.said: The agreements covering television writing have been negotiated with Screen Producers Australia (SPA). … Children’s Television Agreement (CTA) 2011 & Writers Contract with 2026 Rates Miniseries and Telemovies Agreement (MATA) 2010 with 2026 Rates … Series and Serials Agreement (SASA) 2008 with 2026 Rates … The AWG recommended agreements provide writers with favourable terms which are a good starting point for negotiations with producers. … Feature Film Agreement Feature Film Option Agreement – Including Assignment Deed … These are standard minimum rates the AWG has negotiated over many years, and are accepted as an industrial standard.

figures.finding: Screen NSW funds writers' development fees up to A$10,000 for an outline, treatment or scriptment, A$10,000-30,000 for a bible and pilot, and A$20,000 per draft, and expects AWG and award minimums to be paid.
figures.applies: Screen NSW development funding (guide dated 12 July 2024); caps apply only to Screen NSW's contribution.

sources.said: The caps are applicable solely to Screen NSW‘s contribution. … noting that Screen NSW expects the payment of AWG and award minimums. … Writer’s Fees Up to $10,000 Outline, Treatment or Scriptment … Writer’s Fees $10,000 - $30,000 Bible and Pilot episode (incl. polish) … Writer’s Fees Up to $20,000 Per Draft (incl. polish)

figures.finding: AWG full membership needs 50 produced minutes (45 for television) and costs A$325 to A$850 a year by income, plus a A$185 joining fee; associate membership A$210 a year plus A$120.

sources.said: For film, theatre and audio you must have at least 50 minutes of produced work. Television writers must have 45 minutes. … Below $40,000 $27.10 $81.25 $325 … Over $100,000 $70.75 $212.50 $850 … There is a one-off joining fee of $185 for Full membership. … There is a one-off joining fee of $120 for Associate membership.
